title: perf(lsp): get all lines from a file in one go (`locations_to_items`)
body:
Further optimization  to `locations_to_items`, to get all the rows from an URI at once, instead of in multiple calls.

Results of my test that gets references to `vim.loop` inside `neovim` sources:
* without libuv: around 7000ms
* with `get_line`: 28ms
* with this PR: `get_lines`: 10ms
